versions.changelog: Initial release. Eight-phase EU AI Act risk-classification workflow covering system intake and actor-role determination, Article 5 prohibited-practice screen, Article 6(1) safety-component / Annex I path, Article 6(2) Annex III area mapping, Article 6(3) derogation analysis with mandatory documentation, Article 50 transparency-obligation triggers, GPAI / Article 51 systemic-risk tier check, and a dated action checklist mapped to staged enforcement deadlines (2 Feb 2025, 2 Aug 2025, 2 Aug 2026, 2 Aug 2027).
